_about: A VENDOR LISTING page whose entries name parts the way a real Meraki datasheet page does, and the reason src/pipeline/apply-acquired.ts resolves a SKU in five counted steps instead of one string comparison. Run #40 read 179 entries off pages like this and matched 0 parts. Every entry here is one resolution step, and one of them must be REFUSED: the entries carry no facts except the first, so the run's precision audit stays about the fact that actually landed.
_about_entries: NZTEST-MR44 -> variant, through the -HW alias the ADAPTER declared on this page (the catalogue holds only NZTEST-MR44-HW), and the page's own name is then written back as a part_aliases row so the next run reaches it through step 4. NZTEST-MR46 -> nothing: the catalogue holds NZTEST-MR46-HW and this page declared no alias, so the suffix is ours to invent and we do not. nztest-ms130-24p -> case. NZTEST-SPARE-KIT and NZTEST-SPAREBASE= -> the Cisco spare '=' stripped and added. nztest-ddos-10u20g= -> AMBIGUOUS: two catalogue rows differ only by case (127 such pairs in production on 4 Sep 2026) and neither is picked.
